verdict.rationale: Linear's Initiatives feature (assigning a team to lead, proposed/canceled statuses, priority, and private team visibility) lets PMs align multiple teams around a large launch and see its progress, which is the core planning-tracking pattern for cross-team coordination (linear-docs-4, linear-docs-14, linear-docs-28, linear-docs-37, linear-docs-59, linear-docs-76). However, no evidence describes an explicit dependency-tracking mechanism (e.g., blocking/blocked-by relations across teams or a dependency graph view) that a PM would use to manage inter-team blockers. Missing for 10: explicit cross-team issue dependency/blocking relations, a dependency visualization, and independent/community confirmation that this works well in practice for large launches.
